description_en: On Agim Prodani Street, near the police station, a 2+1 apartment is for sale with an area of ​​79m² (gross) and 71m² (net), 3rd residential floor, new building of 2018. The apartment is furnished, sunny orientation and natural light. Has regular mortgage documentation. The price is 140,000 Euros.
